svg.title: Field lines and equipotentials of a point charge
svg.desc: A positive point charge Q at the center. Twelve straight field lines, in blue, point radially outward. Four green equipotential circles surround the charge, drawn for equal steps of potential, so they are closest together near the charge, where the field is strongest. The field lines cross every equipotential at right angles. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Work along and across point-charge equipotentials
An imposed probe path first circles at constant potential, then moves radially outward. Electric work
is −qΔV; tangential motion does no work.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
